meta.name: Pueblo
meta.one_line_vibe: Pueblo stay with a hot tub, a quiet southern Colorado retreat.

arrival.code_delivery: Sent the morning of your arrival. Activates at 4:00 PM unless early check-in has been approved.
arrival.lock_backup_tip: After entering your code, press the 'Check' (or 'Schlage') button to engage the lock. If the door doesn't open, try again slowly, one digit at a time.
arrival.parking: Park in front of the garage or along the street in front of the property.
arrival.towels_location: 10 bath towels in the closet at the end of the hallway (left side). Hand towels are in the cupboard and on top of the sink in each bathroom.
first_steps: Please take luggage directly to your bedroom to protect the floors.
Fire extinguishers are in every bedroom and beneath the kitchen sink.
Front and back doors are the two main exits.
exits: Game room door leading to the hot tub

wifi.notes: If slow: unplug the router for 30 sec and plug back in.

house_rules: Feel free to smoke 420 indoors. Tobacco goes outside, please ($1,000 reset fee if it doesn't).
Quiet hours run 10 PM to 9 AM so the neighbors can rest easy.
Pets are welcome. Keep them off the furniture and clean up after them ($200 if we find a surprise).
Please check with us before adding guests or hosting a party. Unapproved gatherings cancel the stay.
The hot tub and cup holders are not ashtrays ($50 cleanup fee per incident).

mode_setup.must_do_first: Set the tub to ST (Standard) mode or it will not maintain temperature
mode_setup.why: In EC (Economy) mode the heater only runs during filter cycles. Your water cools between them. ST keeps it at your set temp 24/7.
steps: Tap the Warm or Temp button to wake up the display
Press Mode (or hold Warm for 3 sec if no Mode button)
Display cycles through ST → EC → SL, stop when it shows ST
mode_setup.video_tutorial_title: How to set ST vs EC mode (2 min)

quick_start: Confirm the display shows ST (see mode setup above)
Open all jet valves before running the jets
Press the Light button once on the control panel (if you want the LED on)
Close the cover when not in use
hot_tub.water_care: Shock every 2–3 days for light use, or after each heavy / long soak. No food, drinks, glass, or smoking in the water.
rules: No food, drinks, or glass in the tub
Keep water above the filter line, drops below = heater shuts off

grill.notes: Propane grill is available. Bring your own propane or order a tank through the Cynch app.

projector_setup.notes: Backyard projector with Roku stick, use the remote controls to manage all settings for both the projector and the Roku stick. The projector requires no adjustments on arrival. If connecting an external device, check your HDMI cable length (no slack = too short).
roku_app_remote: Install the Roku mobile app and sign in
Connect your phone to the same Wi-Fi as the Roku, then select the Roku device from the list
Use Private Headphones, Guide, Microphone (voice), Star (options), Play/Pause, Keyboard, and Channels/123 buttons as needed

streaming: Sign in with your own accounts
tv.notes: Log out of all streaming apps before checkout.

highlights: Full kitchen, cook what you'd cook at home
Delivery works great: Uber Eats, DoorDash, Grubhub

hair_dryer.location: Under each bathroom sink (one per bathroom)
hair_dryer.notes: If one is missing, message us and we will bring one over.

steps: Bag the trash and move it to the bins near the front entrance
Sign out of any streaming apps on the TVs
Set the hallway thermostat to 66°F in winter, 75°F in summer
Lock up behind you and have a safe trip
checkout.trash_day: Tuesday. Our team comes by to take the trash out and bring the bins back in, nothing for you to do.

temperature.winter_minimum: 66°F, required to prevent pipes from freezing
temperature.notes: Thermostat controls both heat and A/C, adjust freely

eat_in_10.name: Fuel & Iron Food Hall
eat_in_10.reason: Pueblo's first food hall. Five kitchens, a bar, and coffee. Great for indecisive groups.

eat_in_10.name: Bingo Burger
eat_in_10.reason: Widely considered one of the best burgers in Pueblo.

coffee.name: Solar Roast Coffee
coffee.reason: Roasts beans with solar power. Pueblo original, quirky and good.

casual_dinner.name: Brues Alehouse
casual_dinner.reason: Riverwalk gastropub with a rooftop beer garden. Try the slopper (Pueblo specialty).

casual_dinner.name: Angelo's Pizza Parlor
casual_dinner.reason: Family-owned since 1992. Transplanted straight from Brooklyn to the Riverwalk.

parks.name: Historic Arkansas Riverwalk of Pueblo (HARP)
parks.reason: Walkable riverside loop through downtown. Boats, bridges, and plenty of photo ops.

parks.name: Lake Pueblo State Park
parks.reason: Boating, swimming, and hiking. Huge reservoir, classic Colorado day trip.

adventure_day.name: Bishop Castle
adventure_day.reason: Hand-built stone castle in the mountains. Strange, incredible, free to visit.

adventure_day.name: Great Sand Dunes National Park
adventure_day.reason: Tallest dunes in North America. Worth the long drive. Bring a sled.

adventure_day.name: Royal Gorge Bridge
adventure_day.reason: One of the world's highest suspension bridges. Tram, zipline, and views.

late_night.name: Denny's
late_night.reason: Open 24/7 when the Riverwalk has gone to sleep.

parks_local.name: Mineral Palace Park
parks_local.address: 1600 N Santa Fe Ave, Pueblo, CO 81003
parks_local.reason: 57-acre park with an arboretum, pool, playground, fitness trail, and fishing. Pueblo's first major flower gardens.

parks_local.name: University Park
parks_local.reason: Over 6 acres with gazebos and shelters, a quiet hangout.

parks_local.name: Colorado City Recreation District
parks_local.address: 4497 Bent Brothers Blvd, Colorado City, CO 81019
parks_local.reason: Hub of the Greenhorn Valley at ~6,000 ft, with Greenhorn Mountain rising over 12,000 ft to the west.

getting_around.name: Garden of the Gods + Pikes Peak

host_picks.name: Brues Alehouse Brewing Co.
host_picks.meta: Brewery + pub fare · Riverwalk · 8 min · 4 mi
host_picks.body: Patio overlooking the Riverwalk. Solid beer list and burgers + wings.

host_picks.name: Bingo Burger
host_picks.meta: Local burger spot · Downtown · 9 min · 5 mi
host_picks.body: Pueblo-style green chile cheeseburgers. Cash-only sometimes, check the door.
host_picks.order: Bingo Burger with green chile, hand-cut fries.

host_picks.name: D'Angelo's NY Style Pizzeria
host_picks.body: Real New York-style slices in Pueblo. Late-night spot, generous slices.

host_picks.name: Solera
host_picks.body: Sit-down Italian on the Riverwalk. Date-night vibes, pasta done right.

host_picks.name: Mike Salvador's
host_picks.body: Pueblo Mexican classic. Green chile is the move, full of heat and flavor.

host_picks.name: The Pour House
host_picks.body: Casual bar with full menu. Game-day spot with screens up everywhere.

host_picks.name: Park East Tavern
host_picks.body: No-frills local tavern. Cheap beer, friendly crowd, classic burger.

host_picks.name: Hop's House of Pizza
host_picks.body: Pueblo institution since the 60s. Greek-style pizza and gyros.

troubleshooting.fix: Unplug the router for 30 seconds, plug back in, wait 2 min.
Switch input to HDMI 1 using the TV remote (not the Roku remote).
Check the breaker panel, HVAC breaker may have tripped.

how_to_claim: Post a photo from your stay tagged #Kushkations and #KushKations
Leave a five-star review on your booking platform
Email a screenshot to info@kushkations.com, we'll send the code

cleaner_notes: Confirm hot tub is in ST mode after every clean, not EC
Reset thermostat to 68°F after clean, not lower
Empty trash bins and replace liners

tasks: Wipe front door handle and lock panel
Restock paper towels, dish soap, sponge
Check TV remotes in each room
Restock toilet paper (3+ rolls per bath)
Check hair on floor and drains
All trash bagged at outdoor bins
